(R5 impleaded as per order dated 21.3.2018 by this Court in Wmp.3433 of 2018 in Wp.19213 of 2017) 6.Dr.V.Manimaran, Deputy Director, Public Health and Preventive Medicine, Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department,
texts.facts: The petitioner seeks a writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, calling for and quashing a report of the 4 th respondent/referal lab, dated 13.06.2017, that has proceeded on the basis that the tea stocked is 'sub-standard' as defined under Section 3(1)(zx) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (in short 'Act') and does not conform to the standards laid down therein and under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011, on the ground that water soluble ash falls below the minimum standard limit. 2.Pending writ petition, this Court had directed R4 to engage in yet another exercise of assessment of the stock. A counter has been filed by R4 on 14.09.2017 wherein they accede to the position that the earlier report had been issued in error and without taking note of an amendment by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India with effect from 29.12.2016. Paragraphs 6, 8 and 11 of the counter are extracted below: Experts found that there is an inadvertent bonafide calculation error made by the analyst. Consequently analyst has taken the corrective action and re-calculated the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.Nos.19213 & 15336 of 2017 same and submitted the recalculated correct values. Corrective action has been taken in this Mahaveer Tea Company Rep. By Its ... vs The Commissioner on 5 December, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76304604/ 3 regard in the report and same has been amended in the reports and had been submitted. These amended test reports 180F/FSSA/2017, 181F/FSSA/2017, 182F/FSSA/2017, 183F/FSSA/2017, 184F/FSSA/2017, 185F/FSSA/2017 and 186F/FSSA/2017 dated 31.08.2017 will supersede the test reports issued earlier by this laboratory as cited in Para (2). It is humbly requested to this Hon'ble Court that the rest report issued earlier as cited in Para(2) may be treated as cancelled as null and void. 7. .......... 8. ............ In view of non-receipt of official hard copy of the Gazette to the laboratory, inadvertently earlier limit of 150mg/kg has been applied while rendering the opinion on the above said samples. The same has been amended now and copies of reports are enclosed for kind perusal of Hon'ble Court. It is herewith humbly requested that the test report issued earlier as cited in Para(2) may be cancelled as null and void.
